paths.description: Portal homepage: top-story discovery and navigation; representative aggregator template.
Podcasts listing: representative first-party collection/catalog template.
Linked G1 health article: representative completion of the portal’s primary read-a-story journey.
Invalid first-party route: representative HTTP/not-found recovery state.

findings.summary: The site remains light when the user requests a dark color scheme.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots under default and prefers-color-scheme: dark are visually identical; the platform probe reports colorScheme "normal".
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() tokens for surfaces, text, borders, and browser chrome.

findings.summary: Animations continue under reduced-motion preference.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found 19 running 1000–1500 ms animations and no accessible stylesheet containing prefers-reduced-motion.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce layer that removes non-essential animation and disables auto-advance.

findings.summary: The consent banner obscures primary content, especially on mobile.
findings.evidence: Load screenshots show a fixed banner covering the lower desktop viewport and roughly the lower quarter of the 360×800 viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, content-preserving consent surface with clear choices and dismissal; avoid covering the reading area.

findings.summary: Transient consent UI is custom chrome without semantic dialog/popover primitives.
findings.evidence: DOM probe found zero dialog, popover, and details elements while screenshots show a fixed overlay-like consent surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Use an appropriately labelled dialog for the consent decision, manage focus, and provide explicit dismiss/reject controls.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-wide rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero @container rules across the loaded stylesheets despite cards and navigation being reused in differently sized regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for reusable card and navigation components while retaining intrinsic fallback layouts.

findings.summary: Many visible targets are undersized and several focused navigation items have no visible focus indicator.
findings.evidence: The active-control probe found 32 of 38 sampled visible controls below 44 px in one dimension; several focused menu links reported outline-style none and no box shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 44×44 CSS-pixel target areas where practical and define a high-contrast :focus-visible style for every control.

findings.summary: The not-found recovery page renders overlapping, unreadable state text.
findings.evidence: The 404 screenshot shows multiple lines and the attempted URL painted on top of one another beneath “Página não encontrada.”
findings.suggestedFix: Repair the 404 text layout and present clear Home, Back, and Search recovery actions with readable spacing.

findings.summary: Cold mobile performance is far outside good Core Web Vitals thresholds.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 8.0 s, TBT 1,040 ms, Speed Index 18.8 s, and performance score 0.34.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP content, reduce startup JavaScript, and delay advertising, analytics, and media code until after critical content is usable.

findings.summary: Heavy scripting blocks the main thread.
findings.evidence: The trace recorded 8 long tasks and 409.83 ms TBT; Lighthouse measured 18.3 s main-thread work and 4.7 s JavaScript execution.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile long tasks, split execution into prioritized chunks, and move non-UI work off the critical main-thread window.

findings.summary: The critical network path is large and poorly cached.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 323 requests and 9.0 MB transferred; Lighthouse estimated 5.5 MB savings from better cache lifetimes and identified document latency and dependency-tree failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Set long immutable caching for versioned assets, shorten dependency chains, and reserve preload/fetchpriority for verified critical resources.

findings.summary: The page ships several megabytes of unused and legacy JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 4,496 KiB unused JavaScript and 298 KiB legacy JavaScript; HAR attributes 7.56 MB to 59 scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split media, ads, identity, and analytics by actual need; remove duplicate/legacy payloads for modern browsers.

findings.summary: Controls and media expose invalid or missing accessible names and roles.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed aria-allowed-attr, aria-hidden-focus, label/name mismatch, and svg-img-alt; the DOM probe found 3 unnamed links, 3 unnamed buttons, and 2 unlabelled inputs.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each control a stable accessible name, fix ARIA-role combinations, label search inputs, and remove focusable descendants from aria-hidden containers.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 67 color-contrast failures on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Update design tokens so normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text/UI indicators reach applicable WCAG thresholds.

findings.summary: Landmark, heading, list, and focus structure is not coherent.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark and invalid list composition; the DOM exposes 14 H1 elements, many for weather dates and prices, plus navigation links with no visible focus outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one main landmark, establish a single page H1 with nested section headings, repair list markup, and preserve visible focus.

findings.summary: Touch-target sizing falls short despite otherwise successful mobile reflow.
findings.evidence: Mobile layout has no horizontal overflow, but the target probe found 32 sampled controls below 44 px in width or height.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas without changing visual density, and verify at 200–400% zoom and narrow reflow.

findings.summary: The page emits extensive runtime errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured 58 browser console error entries.
findings.suggestedFix: Triage first-party exceptions and failed resources, then gate optional integrations so third-party failure does not flood production consoles.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs, BFCache blockers, and an on-load geolocation request reduce platform hygiene.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported two deprecated API warnings, two BFCache failure reasons, inspector issues, and geolocation requested on page load.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated API use and unload/BFCache blockers; request geolocation only after a clear user action and explanation.

findings.summary: At least one link is not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed the crawlable-anchors audit while the rest of the portal uses real href links.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace script-only navigation with real href destinations and keep descriptive link text.

findings.summary: Sitemap and crawler policy signals are stale or inconsistent.
findings.evidence: robots.txt advertises an HTTP image sitemap; sitemap.xml lists only two HTTP URLs with 2022 lastmod dates, while canonical pages are HTTPS and current.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish current HTTPS sitemap indexes for active templates and align robots sitemap declarations, canonicals, and update dates.

findings.summary: Entity-rich pages omit structured data.
findings.evidence: Both homepage and podcast listing probes found zero JSON-LD blocks despite representing an Organization/WebSite and a podcast collection; Open Graph metadata is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org WebSite/Organization and podcast collection/item JSON-LD that matches visible content.

findings.summary: Cookie transport attributes are unsafe and HSTS is absent.
findings.evidence: Cookie audit found 29 insecure cookies; many use SameSite=None and several persist 390–400 days. Headers include CSP and nosniff but omit HSTS.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure on all HTTPS cookies, use the least-permissive SameSite value, shorten tracking lifetimes, and deploy HSTS after subdomain readiness.

findings.summary: The initial page load has an exceptionally broad tracking footprint.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture contacted 85 third-party origins and 23 known tracker domains; HAR recorded 313 third-party requests and 8.62 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize vendors, delay non-essential tracking until valid consent, batch analytics, and enforce data-retention/vendor budgets.

findings.summary: Geolocation is requested on load rather than in context.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed geolocation-on-start. The visible weather area can instead ask only after the user chooses location-based weather.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer geolocation until an explicit weather-location action; explain the benefit before invoking the browser prompt.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are missing.
findings.evidence: Header audit found no HSTS, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. CSP supplies frame-ancestors and nosniff is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strict Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, deploy HSTS, and keep CSP frame-ancestors narrowly scoped.

findings.summary: Important listing content is only partly available without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 26% raw/rendered token overlap for Podcasts and 55% for the homepage, versus 82% for the linked article.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render podcast names, destinations, and core portal headlines; layer personalization and playback on afterward.

findings.summary: The 404 fallback is visually broken.
findings.evidence: The not-found screenshot shows overlapping explanatory text and URL content, undermining the otherwise available search recovery control.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct the error-page layout and add readable recovery actions tested across current viewport sizes.

findings.summary: Consent presents acceptance without an equally visible rejection choice.
findings.evidence: Desktop, mobile, podcasts, and article screenshots show only “Prosseguir” in the banner; no reject or close action is visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer equally prominent Accept and Reject non-essential cookies actions, preserve refusal, and keep privacy settings reversible.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and misses modern delivery opportunities.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 16 oversized images, 46 legacy-format images, 22 below-fold images not lazy-loaded, 7 missing dimensions, and 6 missing srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants, size them to rendered slots, lazy-load below-fold content, and reserve dimensions.

findings.summary: Advertising, tracking, and media work dominate the initial load.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 323 requests, 125 fetch/XHR calls, and 7.56 MB script transfer; Lighthouse estimated 4.5 MB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical integrations to user intent/idle time, eliminate duplicate analytics paths, and set request/CPU budgets.

findings.summary: Third-party and media payloads are disproportionate to a news portal landing view.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 8.62 MB; a 2.89 MB player bundle loads before explicit playback and tracker capture found 85 third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Load the player only when media approaches the viewport or the user presses play, and enforce vendor byte/request budgets.

findings.summary: The homepage starts with a large memory and DOM footprint.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 1,385,334 nodes and 84.7 MB self size; the repeated menu run snapshot reached 87.5 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce loaded integrations and hidden DOM, release unused media/ad objects, and set a representative memory budget.

taskList.title: Cut startup JavaScript, third-party, advertising, and media cost
Make consent honest, reversible, semantic, and non-obscuring
Repair accessibility semantics, contrast, focus, and target sizing
Harden cookies and browser security policies
Server-render core podcast and portal content
Fix error-state layout and recovery actions
Honor dark mode and reduced motion
Modernize images and responsive component delivery
Repair indexing metadata and sitemap consistency
Remove console errors, deprecated APIs, and BFCache blockers
